entities.name: Anita Angelovska-Bežoska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anita Angelovska-Bežoska is a Macedonian economist who has been serving as Governor of the National Bank of North Macedonia since 2018. Previously, she served as Vice Governor of the National Bank in the period 2011–2018. She has also worked for the Ministry of Finance and the International Monetary Fund.
